import json
e=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f4a2.json'))
p=e['payload']
d=json.JSONDecoder()
for i,c in enumerate(p['bounded_context']):
  if i<3: continue
  s=c['context'];pos=0;objs=[]
  while pos<len(s):
    while pos<len(s) and s[pos].isspace(): pos+=1
    if pos>=len(s): break
    o,pos=d.raw_decode(s,pos);objs.append(o)
  ctx=objs[0]
  print('=====',i,ctx.get('file'),ctx.get('line'),ctx.get('section'),ctx.get('source_tag'))
  print('ADJ',json.dumps(ctx.get('adjacent_translations'),ensure_ascii=False))
  se=ctx.get('source_evidence') or {}
  print('COMP',se.get('component'),se.get('public_source_path'),se.get('source_identity'),se.get('matching_lines'))
  ex=se.get('excerpts') or []
  if ex: print(ex[0]['excerpt'][:1200])
  for o in objs[1:]: print('EXTRA',json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)[:2000])
"
